messages:
finn: heads-up — after landing kernel-selector tweak on canary we started seeing an uptick in host-side tail latency for short requests. p99 went 34ms -> 71ms, system CPU up ~19%.
noor: on it. grabbing flamegraphs and socket stats. initial signal shows a spike in writev calls from tokenizer -> proxy.
amelia: kvcache telemetry also shows async write queue depth rising and a couple of hot-shard spills around the same window.
finn: sanitized log snippet:
```
INGRESS recv stream
tokenizer: emit 48B chunk
proxy: writev([hdr,48,ctl]) -> flush
kernel: sys_writev x3
```
noor: older behavior coalesced many of those into a single ~1KB syscall at proxy. kernel change seems to reduce batching window.
rook: rookie-bot posted CI perf: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/9622/regressions/3344556677 (p99 regression flagged)
amelia: quick local bench: enabling proxy.runtime.coalesce_by_stream_ms=10 drops writev calls ~-70% and restores p99 to ~38ms. kvcache hot-evict rate -45%.
finn: short-term mitigation proposal: flip coalesce_by_stream_ms=10 on canary hosts and monitor ingress_p99, sys_cpu, kvcache.hot_evictions. rollback if p99 > 80ms or error rate rises >0.4%.
noor: long-term idea: teach kernel-selector to emit a "batch_tolerance" hint per-flow. if write_density > threshold, prefer kernels that tolerate a larger batching window (trade slight decode delta for far fewer syscalls).
amelia: small experiment results:
- coalesce_by_stream_ms=10 -> writev -70%, p99 38ms, sys CPU -12%
- tokenizer.min_emit=128 -> helps but increases tokenizer CPU ~5%
- kernel_selector.hint = "balanced" -> fewer small writes but slight median decode +1.5ms
rook: plan: rollout coalesce_by_stream_ms flip to 15% canary at 3344556685, observe for 20m. i'll post snapshots to the perf dashboard after 10m.
finn: i'll prep a PR with microbench numbers and flame links. tagging @noor for kernel-selector follow-up RFC to add batch_tolerance hint.
noor: adding temp alert: kvcache.hot_evictions > 4/s during canary window.
amelia: flip done on canary at 3344556685. monitoring now. :eyes:
rookie-bot: perf snapshot uploaded: https://perf.redwood/internal/snapshots/3344556677/compare (baseline 3344551000).
